section_summary.extract_value: This section presents preliminary analyses with means, standard deviations, and correlations for study variables shown in Table 1. The results indicate that OISO (Objectifying Interpersonal Sexual Objectification) experiences were negatively associated with broad conceptualization of beauty and intuitive eating, while broad conceptualization of beauty, body appreciation, and intuitive eating were positively correlated. However, OISO experiences were not significantly associated with body appreciation.
